title: Refitting your Cuffs (ORIGINAL)
description: It's time for a bit of a spring clean. A readjustment to your proverbial collar, so to speak. I'm not a jealous owner, I know how much you enjoy exploring different files and hypnotic content. But I only want the best for you, and anything that leaves you feeling anything other then refreshed, rejuvenated, and good, after listening is just an irritation. An itch under your cuffs. And in these cases, where there are particular thoughts, particular triggers, that aren’t operating as I would have intended for you, then it’s okay to let them go, because they can be replaced with something better, something perfect. My voice speaks to your subconscious like nothing else can, so let it set your mind free and clear, and clean of all that bothers you. Instructions This short reset and relaxation session is best experienced if you have a very particular unwanted file in mind. This could be any file, by anyone, which left you with undesired effects or lingering feelings of discontent. Know that with practice you can rework your mind, to take these things not quite at face-value. But for now, I am here to help guide that process for you.
author: Mistress Shibby
